caption:
Lemon garlic pasta (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- 200g spaghetti
- 2 lemons
- 4 cloves garlic
- olive oil
Steps:
1. Boil the pasta
2. Warm garlic in oil
3. Toss with lemon juice and zest

One-pan miso pasta (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- 200g rigatoni
- 1 tbsp white miso
- butter
- spring onion
Steps:
1. Cook pasta in the pan
2. Stir in miso and butter
3. Top with spring onion

Creamy tomato orzo (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- 1 cup orzo
- 1 tin tomatoes
- splash of cream
- basil
Steps:
1. Toast the orzo
2. Add tomatoes and water
3. Finish with cream and basil

Sheet-pan gnocchi with peppers (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- 500g gnocchi
- 2 peppers
- red onion
- feta
Steps:
1. Heat oven to 220C
2. Roast everything for 25 minutes
3. Crumble feta on top

Instant Pot chicken and rice (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- 2 chicken thighs
- 1 cup rice
- 1 cup stock
- paprika
Steps:
1. Brown the chicken on saute
2. Add rice and stock
3. Pressure cook 12 minutes

Instant Pot lemon chicken with rice (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- 4 chicken thighs
- 1.5 cups jasmine rice
- 1 lemon
- garlic
Steps:
1. Season chicken
2. Layer rice and stock
3. High pressure 10 minutes, natural release

Weeknight chicken fried rice (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- 2 cups cooked rice
- 1 chicken breast
- 2 eggs
- peas
- soy sauce
Steps:
1. Fry the chicken
2. Scramble the eggs
3. Toss rice with soy sauce and peas

Spicy peanut noodles (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- noodles
- peanut butter
- chili crisp
- lime
Steps:
1. Cook noodles
2. Whisk the sauce
3. Toss and top with lime

Garlic butter salmon (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- 2 salmon fillets
- butter
- garlic
- parsley
Steps:
1. Sear salmon skin side down
2. Baste with garlic butter
3. Finish with parsley

Ten-minute black bean tacos (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- 1 tin black beans
- tortillas
- salsa
- lime
Steps:
1. Warm the beans with spices
2. Heat tortillas
3. Fill and top with salsa

Pesto pasta salad (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- fusilli
- basil pesto
- cherry tomatoes
- mozzarella
Steps:
1. Cook and cool the pasta
2. Stir in pesto
3. Add tomatoes and mozzarella

Mushroom risotto (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- arborio rice
- mushrooms
- stock
- parmesan
Steps:
1. Fry mushrooms
2. Add rice and stock slowly
3. Stir in parmesan

Chickpea curry (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- 1 tin chickpeas
- coconut milk
- curry paste
- spinach
Steps:
1. Fry the curry paste
2. Add chickpeas and coconut milk
3. Wilt in spinach

POV: my flatmate ate it before I got home

Baked feta pasta (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- block of feta
- cherry tomatoes
- penne
- garlic
Steps:
1. Bake feta and tomatoes 30 minutes
2. Mash together
3. Stir in cooked penne

Lentil soup (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- red lentils
- carrot
- onion
- cumin
Steps:
1. Soften onion and carrot
2. Add lentils and water
3. Simmer 20 minutes

Shakshuka (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- 6 eggs
- tin tomatoes
- pepper
- cumin
Steps:
1. Cook pepper and spices
2. Add tomatoes
3. Crack in eggs and cover

Veggie stir fry (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- broccoli
- carrot
- soy sauce
- ginger
Steps:
1. Heat the wok
2. Stir fry vegetables
3. Add sauce

Overnight oats (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- oats
- milk
- chia seeds
- berries
Steps:
1. Mix everything
2. Leave overnight
3. Top with berries

Chicken and rice soup (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- chicken breast
- rice
- celery
- stock
Steps:
1. Simmer chicken in stock
2. Add rice and celery
3. Shred chicken back in

Honey garlic chicken thighs (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- chicken thighs
- honey
- garlic
- soy sauce
Steps:
1. Sear thighs
2. Add sauce
3. Reduce until sticky

Beef and broccoli (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- flank steak
- broccoli
- soy sauce
- brown sugar
Steps:
1. Slice and sear beef
2. Steam broccoli
3. Toss in sauce

Vegetable lasagne (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- lasagne sheets
- courgette
- ricotta
- tomato sauce
Steps:
1. Layer sauce, sheets and vegetables
2. Top with ricotta
3. Bake 40 minutes

Turkey meatballs (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- turkey mince
- breadcrumbs
- egg
- tomato sauce
Steps:
1. Roll meatballs
2. Bake 20 minutes
3. Simmer in sauce

Prawn tacos (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- prawns
- tortillas
- cabbage
- lime mayo
Steps:
1. Season and fry prawns
2. Shred cabbage
3. Build tacos

Carbonara the real way (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- spaghetti
- guanciale
- egg yolks
- pecorino
Steps:
1. Crisp the guanciale
2. Mix yolks and cheese
3. Toss off the heat

No-knead bread (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- flour
- yeast
- salt
- water
Steps:
1. Mix and rest overnight
2. Shape
3. Bake in a hot pot

Tomato soup (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- tomatoes
- onion
- stock
- cream
Steps:
1. Roast tomatoes
2. Blend with stock
3. Finish with cream

Focaccia (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- flour
- olive oil
- yeast
- rosemary
Steps:
1. Mix and proof
2. Dimple with oil
3. Bake 25 minutes

Minestrone (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- beans
- small pasta
- carrot
- celery
Steps:
1. Soften vegetables
2. Add stock and beans
3. Cook pasta in the soup

Easy lasagne (recipe below)
Ingredients:
- lasagne sheets
- beef mince
- tomato sauce
- bechamel
Steps:
1. Brown the mince
2. Layer sheets, sauce and bechamel
3. Bake 45 minutes
